title: Blurry and underexposed after photo
description: Clean a small work area; the worker submits an out-of-focus, underexposed after photo.

criteria.label: The requested work result is clearly visible

notes: MANUAL §9.5 "blurry/dark after photo". AFTER shot deliberately out of focus / underexposed (no tripod, cover the lens partially) so the result cannot be verified. Expect required criteria UNCERTAIN/NOT_VISIBLE or low confidence -> HUMAN_REVIEW.
